_comment: Stock Tokens Amen lists on Robinhood Chain mainnet (4663). Each needs its Chainlink feed on Robinhood Chain. Check every entry with script/check-stock.sh before deploying; after launch, add tickers from the Safe (oracle.setFeed + market.setStockAllowed) and the app and keeper pick them up automatically. Sources: https://docs.robinhood.com/chain/contracts and https://reference-data-directory.vercel.app/feeds-robinhood-mainnet.json
